METHODOLOGY

How we document upgrades

NepoCore Upgrade Atlas is an independent reference for laptop RAM and storage.

What we check

We read Lenovo’s platform specifications for memory, storage and configuration restrictions. Support pages document the machine-type codes shown. Some platforms have additional regional or special-bid types beyond those listed. Platforms with different generations or processor variants have separate entries.

How to read the evidence

Manufacturer documented
The linked reference gives a specification or an explicit supported value.
Conditional
A value depends on the unit’s configuration, region, adapter or another stated condition.
Factory or Lenovo offering
A listed or tested configuration identified in the manufacturer’s reference.
Independent test
An independently documented hardware result with its own source. The first release contains no such entries.
Unknown
The cited evidence leaves the value open. Unverified possibilities do not inform compatibility claims.

Corrections

The correction contact is currently unavailable.
